vector_memory.semantic_summary: This module acts as the authentication router, managing all API endpoints related to device pairing, session management, and device listing. It serves as a controller layer, delegating core authentication logic to the AuthService dependency. Key functionalities include initiating pairing, finalizing sessions via secure cookies, and enforcing access control using the `require_device` dependency for protected routes.
